recap.text: Dante, a crocodilian Thief and author of the Third Edition of the Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook, works as a Trap Master guild instructor. He and a skyfowl named Justice Light are reassigned as snow castle guard captains. When ordered twice to kill the ice elf servants, Dante refuses. A beam from the sky kills him, fourteen seasons before his exit.

beats.headline: A newsletter read three times
beats.text: For the record: the subject, a crocodilian, reads Damien's newsletter a third time beside his skyfowl neighbour, Justice Light, whose talon is shaking. Workers are being reassigned for an entire floor, which happens when the showrunners are cheap, and the Reavers are cheap. Justice Light is worried about his shop, his shelves and his art. The subject tells him they are to be snow castle guard captains in a settlement, still white-tagged, and that it is expensive for the showrunners if they die. That is not exactly true. He considers small lies acceptable when they calm a skyfowl.
beats.gist: Dante, a crocodilian, tells Justice Light they will be snow castle guard captains.

beats.headline: One entry, and a brother
beats.text: The subject recognised Justice Light for what he was once the skyfowl started making familiar choices. It is obvious when someone has the cookbook, to anyone who has owned it. He applied at once to move from the lockpicking guild to the trap master guild, to be near his brother. He has never told Justice Light who he is, though neither of them has the cookbook any more. He wrote a single entry in it, afraid of being caught, and watching those who came after pour themselves into it has only made him feel worse. Guilt, maybe.
beats.gist: Dante recognizes Justice Light and moves to the trap master guild to be near his brother.

beats.headline: Fourteen seasons from freedom
beats.text: The eighth floor this season is mountains joined by wires and gondolas, and its crawlers are a flightless mantis who do poorly in the cold. The subject is watching one named York carefully. He has 14 seasons left, and he can taste freedom. Justice Light says he cannot fight crawlers; he means to refuse. What happens to him then? Nothing good, says the subject. He envies the skyfowl his conviction. He has a lot of violence in his heart, and he wants it aimed only at those who deserve it. His last recorded thought on the matter: fuck you all.
beats.gist: Dante is a guild instructor with fourteen seasons left until freedom.

beats.headline: Refused to follow orders
beats.text: Dante, crocodilian, is dead. Class: Thief. Top level: 89. Dungeon exit: took a deal at the beginning of the 11th floor. Worked as a Game Guide and Guildhall Instructor in the Trap Master guild. Died 14 seasons short of his exit, while temporarily reassigned as an Ice Castle guard, by administrative action, for refusing to follow orders. Author of the Third Edition of the Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook. The file does not say what the orders were. It lists his current status in one word: dead.
beats.gist: Dante is a dead crocodilian Thief who wrote the Third Edition of the Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook.

beats.headline: No third warning
beats.text: Justice Light tells the rest to Juice Box. The castle was full of ice elf servants, gentle creatures who loved puzzles and the snow, and over weeks they became the two guards' friends. At the end of the floor, off camera, the guards were ordered to kill them all. The subject looked up into the air and said he would not. They ordered a second time. He refused again. There was no third warning: a beam came from the sky and he was simply gone. Justice Light calls it execution by the AI, which is rare. He says the subject died free.
beats.gist: Justice Light says the AI executed a former crawler for refusing to kill ice elves.
